# FiftyOne

Skills that teach agents to work with FiftyOne. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [voxel51/fiftyone-skills](https://github.com/voxel51/fiftyone-skills), at commit `8b87bef`.

Build high-quality datasets and computer vision models.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **FiftyOne**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **FiftyOne**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install fiftyone@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

18 skills: `fiftyone-app-playwright`, `fiftyone-code-style`, `fiftyone-create-notebook`, `fiftyone-dataset-curation`, `fiftyone-dataset-export`, `fiftyone-dataset-import`, `fiftyone-dataset-inference`, `fiftyone-develop-plugin`, `fiftyone-embeddings-visualization`, `fiftyone-eval-plugin`, `fiftyone-find-duplicates`, `fiftyone-generate-data-lens-connector`, `fiftyone-issue-triage`, `fiftyone-model-evaluation`, `fiftyone-sdk-guidance`, `fiftyone-troubleshoot`, `fiftyone-voodo-design`, `fiftyone-zoo-remote-model`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

3 script files ship inside the skills. The agent can run them on your machine. Read them first.

18 documents show install commands that pipe a download into a shell (`curl ... | sh`). The agent may suggest them. Read the script before you run it.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `HF_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`. This plugin does not store them.
